summary: Verified frozen file hashes and passing controller checks: 40 focused tests, 1122 full tests, and catalogue output. Independent production probes and the focused rerun passed. Required regression and subprocess-isolation guards remain incomplete; two faulty implementations passed all 40 tests.

issues.description: All three cross-split containment fixtures also violate global ID ordering. Removing only motif_split.py's cross-split rejection leaves all 40 tests passing because ordering validation rejects these fixtures instead. The duplicate-key test at line 617 also covers only train-to-train duplication, omitting the explicitly required cross-split case.
issues.required_change: Keep cross-split edge fixtures otherwise valid: use CJC contained_ids=['CC','CJ','CJC'], CCC=['CC','CI','CCC'], and CIC=['CC','CI','CIC']. Add a duplicate complete-key rejection case spanning two splits.
issues.validation: The corrected tests must pass against the submitted implementation and fail when the cross-split rejection is removed. Cross-split duplicate keys must raise the exact contracted RuntimeError.

issues.description: Changing only upstream summary/buckets leaves every measured edge unchanged, so this test cannot distinguish computation from constants. An in-memory mutant fixing containment_edges=144 and the matrix to 72/36/36 passed all 40 tests, contrary to the required fixed-summary regression guard.
issues.required_change: Add an explicitly synthetic dependency fixture with otherwise valid rows but changed same-split containment. For example, replace CJC's contained_ids with ['CJC']; assert the returned list, total edges 143, proper edges 63, and train diagonal 71, with other cells unchanged.
issues.validation: The new test must pass against the current implementation and fail against hardcoded edge-summary and matrix mutants. Retain the real-report checks for 144/64 and 72/36/36.

issues.description: Step 5 requires every test subprocess to verify both kmesh and target-module realpaths. The shared child helper checks types and motif_split but never kmesh; the standalone scripts at lines 528 and 545 also omit kmesh, and the latter checks no target origin.
issues.required_change: Add explicit current-worktree realpath assertions for kmesh.__file__ and motif_split's origin in every subprocess script, preferably through a shared helper. Preserve explicit -B.
issues.validation: Verify these assertions execute in each subprocess, including failure-path tests, and rerun all three required controller checks.
